Name: Mint Go Brrr
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]Serving up only the finest ~immersion~, this mod changes mint from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia More Crops[/url], or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22490]Bonster's Combined Crops and Recipes [/url]﻿to be the menace everyone knows and loves/hates. 

Using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975]Machine Terrain Framework[/url], mint has a chance of doing the following:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]spontaneously appearing in empty tilled dirt[/size]
[*][size=3]spreading from existing mint plants into empty tilled dirt[/size]
[*][size=3]replanting itself after being harvested or destroyed[/size]
[*][size=3]taking over other crops and transforming them into mint as well[/size]
[/list][size=3]
This mod also changes mint in all three mods to be an all-seasons crop that's worth 16g and edits WAG's mint to take 7 days to reach full growth.

Why would you want a mod that makes mint a pain in the backside to deal with? Maybe you like a challenge. Maybe you like immersion. Maybe you're roleplaying that you're an organic toothpaste entrepreneur who makes their millions from growing their own mint. The choice is yours! I made this because I thought the idea would be funny, because mint taking over everything is a running joke with friends, and as a warm-up for a larger mod using MTF coming soon. Enjoy!

[/size][size=5][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size][size=3]

This mod requires:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975]Machine Terrain Framework[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][size=3][size=3]and at least one of:
[/size][/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url]﻿[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia More Crops[/url]﻿[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22490]Bonster's Combined Crops and Recipes[/url]﻿[/size][/size]
[/list][size=3]It can be used with any combination of the three crop mods or all three, but [b]will do nothing if none of them are installed[/b]. It does not add mint by itself.

[/size][size=5][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size][size=3][b]
[/b][b]
[/b]To install, simply download the mod, unzip it, and drop the "[CP] Mint Go Brrr" folder into your Mods folder.

[/size][size=5][b]CREDITS[/b][/size][size=3][b]

[/b]Big thanks to Selph for adding the crop behaviour expansion features to Machine Terrain Framework and answering my code questions! Thanks as well to Wildflour, 6480, and Bonster for their permission to [s]turn their mint evil[/s] edit their mods and create this little add-on and thanks to Quill for the mod name! <3[/size]
